answers.text: I completed my BCom in Lucknow this year. My final project was a survey of 40 shoppers about how they use UPI for small purchases. Most said they use it for amounts below a few hundred rupees but still carry cash for vegetable vendors. I have no work experience yet. I want to do an MBA because I have studied accounts but have not learned how a financial company chooses its customers.
I am a quick learner and a good communicator. I believe in teamwork and hard work, and I am passionate about learning new things every day.
The survey results were very interesting and gave many insights about consumer behaviour in the digital era. I think it was a meaningful experience for me.
Do you know which is better for evening snacks, samosa or kachori? We always argue at home. I think kachori is better, especially from Lucknow's old market.
I don't know how many of the 40 shoppers were women. I did not note down gender separately in my sheet.
